opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger of imprisonment, injury or death, providing temporary refuge (postdoctoral placements or PhD places) at universities and research institutions, mostly in the UK, until they can return home. Cara checks applicants' backgrounds and references, encourages them to identify host institutions, negotiates placements, allocates additional funding, and helps with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members. Awards are typically 2- or 3-year placements.
